from limiter import Limiter

def test_basic_allow():
    l = Limiter(rate=10, burst=5)
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == False  # burst exhausted

def test_refill():
    l = Limiter(rate=10, burst=5)
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == False
    assert l.allow("a", 1.0) == True  # 10 tokens refilled but capped at burst=5, consume 1

def test_new_key_full():
    l = Limiter(rate=10, burst=3)
    assert l.allow("x", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("x", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("x", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("x", 0.0) == False
    # New key starts full
    assert l.allow("y", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("y", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("y", 0.0) == True

def test_independent_keys():
    l = Limiter(rate=10, burst=2)
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == False
    # key "b" is independent
    assert l.allow("b", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("b", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("b", 0.0) == False

def test_time_going_backwards():
    l = Limiter(rate=10, burst=5)
    l.allow("a", 0.0)
    try:
        l.allow("a", -1.0)
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_rate_zero_raises():
    try:
        Limiter(rate=0, burst=5)
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_rate_negative_raises():
    try:
        Limiter(rate=-1, burst=5)
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_burst_less_than_one_raises():
    try:
        Limiter(rate=10, burst=0)
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_burst_fractional_raises():
    try:
        Limiter(rate=10, burst=0.5)
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_partial_refill():
    l = Limiter(rate=10, burst=5)
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True  # 4 left
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True  # 3 left
    # Wait 0.05 seconds -> 0.5 tokens refilled -> 3.5
    assert l.allow("a", 0.05) == True  # 2.5 left
    # Wait 0.1 seconds -> 1.0 more -> 3.5
    assert l.allow("a", 0.15) == True  # 2.5 left
    # Wait 0.25 seconds -> 2.5 more -> 5.0 (capped at burst)
    assert l.allow("a", 0.4) == True  # 4.0 left

def test_exact_burst_cap():
    l = Limiter(rate=10, burst=5)
    l.allow("a", 0.0)  # consume 1, 4 left
    l.allow("a", 0.0)  # consume 1, 3 left
    # Wait 1 second -> 3 + 10 = 13, capped at 5
    assert l.allow("a", 1.0) == True  # 4 left
    assert l.allow("a", 1.0) == True  # 3 left
    assert l.allow("a", 1.0) == True  # 2 left
    assert l.allow("a", 1.0) == True  # 1 left
    assert l.allow("a", 1.0) == True  # 0 left
    assert l.allow("a", 1.0) == False  # no tokens

def test_rate_one():
    l = Limiter(rate=1, burst=1)
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == False
    assert l.allow("a", 1.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 1.0) == False

def test_allow_with_same_time_no_refill():
    l = Limiter(rate=10, burst=5)
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == True
    assert l.allow("a", 0.0) == False  # all consumed

if __name__ == "__main__":
